Dave Matthews Band
August 21st, 2021
Merriweather Post Pavilion
Columbia, Md

Source: AKG C460Bs/CK 63-ULS (Back of pit, inline with stage left stack, ~10-12' on stand)->Kind Kables->Naiant LittleBox->Segue Dogstar Silver-Clad Interconnect->Edirol R-09HR (24 bit/48 kHz)
Transfer: SDHC -> PC
Processing: Fade in, fade out & tracking using SoundForge 11.0
Conversion: WAV -> Flac Level 8 using Trader's Little Helper
Recorded by: Tim Brown (<email>)

Notes:
Thanks to Josh for the tickets. FedEx overnight is a very reliable service.
Thanks to Jess & Phil for driving.
Shout outs to Matt & Heather.

Just after One Sweet World began, security asked me to move over to the far right. I politely declined. I compromised by lowering the stand ~2'. I inched it back to ~12' by Tripping Billies.

The stand took a direct hit from a very tall bro. His bro pushed him at the beginning of Ants Marching. It was his first show and lucky for him Twisted Tea was sponsoring him for the evening. Congrats bros, you are absolute douche nozzles. The stand toppled over a bit but was caught by our neighbors, Sheila & company (I think?). The stand was back up and stable within a few seconds. Everyone else around was awesome and made for an enjoyable pit experience. 

Erin, thanks for being the best show buddy. 18 years;)
